{"id":2017869870,"question_id":3742,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780207597,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2017869870/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Number of Items From Sale I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int n;\n    vector<int>freecopies;\n\n    int byrec(vector<vector<int>>& items , int budget , int i)\n    {\n        if(i >= n) return 0;\n\n        int ans = 0;\n\n        int price = items[i][1];\n\n        //take \n        if(budget >= price)\n        {\n            for(int purchase = 1 ; purchase * price <= budget ; purchase++)\n            {\n                ans = max(ans , purchase + freecopies[i] + byrec(items , budget - (purchase * price) , i+1));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // dont take\n        ans = max(ans , byrec(items , budget , i+1));\n        return ans;\n    }\n\n    int maximumSaleItems(vector<vector<int>>& items, int budget) {\n        n = items.size();\n\n        freecopies.assign(n , 0);\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                int factor = items[j][0];\n\n                if(i != j and (factor % items[i][0] == 0)) freecopies[i]++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return byrec(items , budget , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-number-of-items-from-sale-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2042}
